basic_info.description: Welcome to 30 Gilroy Street, a modern 5-bed, 3-bath San Francisco retreat with over 2,200 sq ft of flexible living space. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers a spacious and versatile layout that fits a variety of lifestyles. The upper level features an open-concept design with bay and city views, a generous living room, dining area, and a stylish kitchen with quartz countertops, glass tile backsplash, large island, and stainless steel appliances, including a smart fridge with tablet hub. Three bedrooms and two full baths include a primary suite with walk-through closet and ensuite. Downstairs offers two additional bedrooms, a full bath, a wet bar with wine fridge and storage, and attached 2-car garage with additional backyard access. Thoughtful upgrades throughout include hardwood flooring upstairs, luxury vinyl plank flooring downstairs, espresso-trimmed frosted closet doors, wood slat accents, and a modern fireplace. The terraced, low-maintenance backyard is perfect for entertaining and relaxing in the sun. Smart home features include Ring, Nest, Treatlife lighting, and USB outlets. Conveniently located near multiple parks, walking trails, Caltrain, Highway 101 and 280, with easy access to downtown San Francisco.  This home truly has it all!!
